name: Singapore Institute of Technology
description: The Singapore Institute of Technology is a public university established in 2009 and granted Autonomous University status in 2014, with its main campus in Punggol. It offers applied, industry-focused degrees in engineering, health sciences, infocomm technology, business and design, including programmes run with overseas partner universities.
whyIncluded: One of Singapore's Ministry of Education (MOE)-funded Autonomous Universities, and the main local applied-degree pathway for polytechnic graduates who would otherwise consider overseas study.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering with Honours in Electrical and Electronic Engineering
programmes.notes: SIT charges per credit, fixed for the AY2026 intake cohort: SC S$131.00, PR S$225.00, international (non-ASEAN, MOE Tuition Grant) S$371.69 per credit (ASEAN S$324.82; non-subsidised S$575.52). Annual figure = per-credit fee x 60 credits (240-credit, 4-year programme). SC/PR fees exclude GST (subsidised by MOE); international fees include 9% GST. No compulsory fees are listed in the fee schedule. 2025 history: AY2025 schedule (SC S$130.00, PR S$225.00, IS S$371.69 per credit).

programmes.name: Master of Science in Electrical and Electronic Engineering
programmes.notes: Per-credit fees fixed for the AY2026 postgraduate intake cohort: SC S$156.50 and PR S$318.00 (MOE-subsidised, excl. GST); international students pay the non-subsidised rate of S$641.47 per credit incl. 9% GST. Annual figure = per-credit fee x 30 credits (60-credit programme, 2-year normal candidature per the SIT programme page; classes on weekday evenings). No compulsory fees listed. SIT has no computing, business, sciences or arts master's degree by coursework.
